inspected_frames.observation: Broad paddle, two simple pod rows, plain stem and flattened holdfast retained. New same-five unit crests are readable without changing the outline.
Simpler posterior surface and axial rachis present; disk and stalk connected.
64 serial pods arranged in two rows, no fractal branches; apical pods not overhanging backing.
Deliberately thin fossil-form sculpture has nonzero thickness and stout stem; no apparent floating pieces.
Continuous plain backing has no open cracks or false exposed tube roots.
Thin backing and holdfast disk shown edge-on, as expected for upright lamina.
All64 simple pods and their integrated shallow corrugation visibly present as real geometry; no texture-based unit cues.
Broad rounded paddle, smooth stem and flattened disk read cleanly.

supplementary_detail.observed_note: Individually viewed exact-subject additional detail; see final-detail-inspection and Arborea r003 record. Does not replace any of eight original full views.

concept_comparison: Retain broad oval/paddle silhouette, disk and stout smooth stem. Concept has too few large inflated pods and little unit subdivision; model32 modules per row and five modest unit cues on each, with much shallower relief. Keep a continuous backing and preserve a distinct plain stem.
known_limitations: A genus/species-level idealized positive fossil-form sculpture, not a replica of one fossil or a claim of living color. SAM P19690a supports complete outline but has a short stem; longer plain stem is an artistic choice within reported variable stem lengths. Relief, thickness and overall dimensions are interpretive. No exposed internal tube bundles or roots.
Color, thickness and idealized proportions are artistic except explicitly source-bounded hard ranges; no original specimen cast claim.
CPU stills and Node parsing are not actual GPU or composed-scene acceptance.
